title: Shpilka–Volkovich hitting for low-width ROABPs with a low-degree monomial
author: Ivan Hu, Dieter van Melkebeek, and Andrew Morgan
work: Polynomial Identity Testing via Evaluation of Rational Functions
source_version: Theory of Computing20 (2024), Article1, publisher source publicationJuly 18, 2024; DOI10.4086/toc.2024.v020a001

source_locator.proof_scope: Selected Theorem1.9 exactly, with complete supporting Section8 width/rank characterization, homogeneous reduction, adjacent-block equations, zero-block restriction, partition-selection argument and full derivative/Cauchy proof through Claim8.9. Theorem1.10 is explicitly equivalent by complementation and is uncounted support. No conflation with646/Theorem1.8.

difficulty_reason: The hitting property requires ruling out low-width ROABPs using block-diagonal monomial coefficient matrices and adjacent-block linear constraints derived from vanishing. Section8 builds a zero-block restriction argument, derivative-rank induction and full-rank Cauchy-matrix obstruction to obtain the width bound for arbitrary variable orders, which are substantive research-level obligations beyond routine qualification-exam rank calculations.
